title: A/P Detail lists the five buckets in fixed order and rows by name
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The report has open documents in all five aging buckets on today's date.
  • In the "1-30 days past due" bucket, {Vendor-A} has one open bill, {Bill-A}, and {Vendor-B} has two, {Bill-B} and {Bill-C}. {Vendor-B}'s name comes first alphabetically, and {Bill-B}'s number is smaller than {Bill-C}'s but has fewer digits.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-09 Baker and {Vendor-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-09 Abbott; {Bill-B} is S1-99 and {Bill-C} is S1-100 (the app assigns the real numbers).
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Detail is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the bucket rows from top to bottom without expanding anything.
  2. Click the chevron of the "1-30 days past due" bucket to expand it.
  3. Read the order of {Bill-A}, {Bill-B} and {Bill-C} inside the bucket.
  4. Look at the header of the "Vendor Name" column.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the buckets read, in this order: "91 or more days past due", "61-90 days past due", "31-60 days past due", "1-30 days past due", "Current".
  • Step 2: the bucket opens and shows its rows.
  • Step 3: {Vendor-B}'s two bills come first, {Bill-B} above {Bill-C} (smaller number first, counted as a number), then {Vendor-A}'s {Bill-A}.
  • Step 4: "Vendor Name" is marked as the sorted column.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S1-R5: “A/R Detail and A/P Detail keep their aging buckets in this fixed order: "91 or more days past due", "61-90 days past due", "31-60 days past due", "1-30 days past due", "Current". Inside each bucket, rows open in customer or vendor name order (S1-R2 to S1-R4), ties by document number (S2-R4).”
  • S1-R7: “The column the report opened on is marked as sorted: the name column on the Summaries and Detail reports, the Date column on Collection and Unpaid Invoices.”
  • S2-R4: “ID and No. sort by number value: S1-99 before S1-100 before S1-101. The same number-aware order breaks ties in every sort.”
  • What changes for existing users: “A/P Detail opens with rows in vendor name order inside each bucket (today: most overdue first).”
